title: Explore provenance record JMAP type
description: Explore a JMAP-family data type for structured, versioned records with provenance (basis, confidence, evidence, validUntil) plus curation and age-based retention, carried in Agora Spaces as sequenced-v1 like FileNode, for shared agent/community memory. Inspired by DTG rooms SealedRecordBody (records/put, records/curate). Constraints: no Agora core change; exact-bytes signing, not JCS; any permitted member writes; the draft belongs in Mark's jmap drafts (D5: do not edit ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec without Mark). Output: design notes in notes/, decision on whether to pursue.
